opening.argument: The presentation centers on a network marketing plan requiring an upfront partnership payment and pool purchase: it says, “Firstly, you need to make your own deposit in a 99$ pool” and shows additional priced options. It then promises daily Bitcoin-derived amounts, stating that “For each pool that you have purchased, you get daily percent of all Bitcoins.” The structure further ties compensation to recruitment, including commissions from personally invited partners and their auto reinvestments, while presenting ClapCoins as something to hold for possible price appreciation. These features support the stated position. Although the description calls the video educational and mentions exchange risks, the creator’s precise relationship to the offer remains unclear, and the supplied materials do not establish that payments, returns, or bonuses actually occurred.

citations.quote: Firstly, you need to make your own deposit in a 99$ pool and then you can decide which of the different options for your pool is for you Pool №1 for 500$
For each pool that you have purchased, you get daily percent of all Bitcoins
From the first and the second personally invited partners, we receive each time from their auto reinvestment by 10%.
